title: Piece of Plastic Crap!
text: Piece of Plastic Crap!. The tie rack was supposed to replace the one similar to it that I already have that broke. I received it and put batteries in it, loaded it with my ties and turned it on, it seems as though the ties are too much weight for the belt that rotates and I didn't even have it filled. I had to return, what a shame.

product_metadata.title: Richards Operated/Black Homewares Motorized Tie Rack with LED Lights – Rotating with Batteries – Hold up to 64 Ties and 8 Belts – Standard Rods Good for Most Closet Types
features: MOTORIZED - The Tie/Belt Rack rotates so your tie selection can be made in seconds. There are two buttons that allow the tie rack to rotate in either direction. When rotating, a LED light comes on to help see so you can choose the perfect tie for the day. Each tie hook is smooth and has a raised ending to keep ties in place.

ORGANIZE 64 TIES OR BELTS- The perfect solution to organize your tie collection quickly. Organize ties by Holiday, Seasonal, Stripes, Foulards, Paisleys, Plaids, Polka Dots, Bow Ties, solids or by color. So easy to find the perfect tie for any occasion. There are 4 belt hooks underneath the unit to easily hold 8 belts.
PERFECT GIFT - Great gift for the tie collector or someone just starting out in the professional world. Father’s Day, Graduation, Birthdays, Anniversaries or Christmas.

EASY INSTALLATION- The Revolving Tie Rack securely mounts to standard closet rods. The top screws allow adjustability for most closet rods. Belt hooks fit into a slot and turn to lock into place. Dimensions are approx. 5.5” H x 15” W x 6” D. Uses 4-C batteries (not included). The battery compartment is on top so batteries are easy to replace without taking the unit off the rod.
description: Richards Homewares- Revolving Tie Rack-Black-ABS Plastic- Holds 64 ties and 8 belts-Dual direction rotation- LED light for easy visibility- Requires 4 C batteries.
